title: What is a desktop environment?
summary: A desktop environment is a bundle of programs that provides a complete graphical user interface, including a window manager, file manager, and settings. It allows you to interact with your computer using icons and windows instead of just text commands.

aliases.text: difference between window manager and desktop environment
разница оконный менеджер и рабочее окружение

steps.explain: A desktop environment (DE) bundles together components like icons, toolbars, and a window manager to provide a consistent graphical experience. Unlike a standalone window manager, a DE includes integrated applications and utilities.
